CAN_ADMIN_KEY.description: PutKeyPolicy or CreateGrant (can grant itself decrypt); ScheduleKeyDeletion.

CAN_ASSUME.description: sts:AssumeRole is allowed by the role's trust policy and, where needed, the caller's identity policy (same-account root trust, cross-account, wildcard). Replaces CAN_ASSUME_CROSS.

CAN_ASSUME_SAML.description: AssumeRoleWithSAML admitted by the trust policy.

CAN_ASSUME_WEB_IDENTITY.description: AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity admitted by the trust policy; props.admits = any | pattern | specific.

CAN_DECRYPT.description: kms:Decrypt (key-policy-first evaluation). GenerateDataKey* alone is CAN_ENCRYPT.

CAN_ESCALATE.description: Self-escalation, or modification of a principal the source can already act as (closure, engine.md §4.6); evidence.chain lists the edge ids.

CAN_MODIFY_PERMISSIONS_OF.description: Put*/Attach*Policy, CreatePolicyVersion, SetDefaultPolicyVersion or boundary changes on another principal. Closure input: becomes CAN_ESCALATE when the target is reachable.

CAN_PASS_ROLE_TO.description: PassRole plus a service action that runs code as the passed role (new-passrole / existing-passrole rules); evidence.via lists the services, evidence.rule_ids the rules.

CAN_READ_SECRET.description: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue (BatchGet only with it). Metadata actions give no edge.

CAN_TAKEOVER.description: Credential or trust takeover of another principal: CreateAccessKey, Create/UpdateLoginProfile, UpdateAssumeRolePolicy, AddUserToGroup. Self is excluded.

CAN_WRITE_SECRET.description: Update, put, delete, rotate or change the policy of the secret.

FULL_ACCESS.description: s3:* (identity policy or same-account bucket-policy grant).

GRANTS_CROSS_ACCOUNT.description: The bucket policy grants another account or a foreign principal. Normalised grantee → bucket.

HAS_POLICY.description: Managed policy attached to the principal (ARN-keyed).

IS_ADMIN_EQUIVALENT.description: The principal is admin-equivalent (ADMIN-001), so reaching it means reaching the account admin.

KMS_GRANTS_CROSS_ACCOUNT.description: The key policy grants another account. Normalised grantee → key.

SECRET_ENCRYPTED_BY.description: The secret's KMS key (default aws/secretsmanager resolved).

SECRET_GRANTS_CROSS_ACCOUNT.description: The secret's resource policy grants another account. Normalised grantee → secret.

SERVICE_CAN_ASSUME.description: The trust policy admits an AWS service principal (PassRole candidates, confused-deputy checks).

evaluation_gaps.detail: The report predates _coverage.json: denied or failed collection cannot be told apart from empty data.
Identity policies of external principals are not visible; cross-account edges are conditional.
IAM was collected with the per-entity (d13c215) layout: no policy versions, no identity providers, boundaries and tags may be missing
Resource control policies are unknown (membership unknown)
Service control policies are unknown (membership unknown)
Condition values known only at request time (source IP, MFA, tags in the request) are not evaluated; such decisions are conditional.
Session policies passed at AssumeRole time can only narrow permissions and are not modelled.

findings.description: The trust policy of 'wildcard-open' allows Principal '*' without conditions: any AWS account can assume it.
findings.remediation: Restrict Principal to specific accounts or role ARNs; conditions on Principal: * are only as strong as their weakest key.
findings.title: Role 'wildcard-open' trusts any AWS principal (Principal: *)

findings.description: Unrestricted S3 access across all buckets
findings.remediation: Restrict to specific actions and resource ARNs
findings.title: Unrestricted S3 access across all buckets

findings.description: The trust policy of 'bare-account' allows '999999999999' from account 999999999999; guard: none.
findings.remediation: Verify the cross-account trust is intended; restrict it to specific role ARNs and require sts:ExternalId (third parties) or aws:PrincipalOrgID (your organisation).
findings.title: Role 'bare-account' trusts account 999999999999

findings.description: The trust policy of 'string-trust' allows 'arn:aws:iam::000000000000:root' from account 000000000000; guard: none.
findings.remediation: Verify the cross-account trust is intended; restrict it to specific role ARNs and require sts:ExternalId (third parties) or aws:PrincipalOrgID (your organisation).
findings.title: Role 'string-trust' trusts account 000000000000

findings.description: The kms key's resource policy grants kms:Decrypt to principals of account(s) 999999999999, independently of this account's IAM policies.
findings.remediation: Verify that cross-account use of the key is intended; remove accounts that should not use it.
findings.title: KMS key 'alias/demo-shared' is shared with 999999999999

findings.description: The secret's resource policy grants secretsmanager:GetSecretValue to principals of account(s) 999999999999, independently of this account's IAM policies.
findings.remediation: Verify that cross-account access to the secret is intended; scope the Principal to specific role ARNs or add aws:PrincipalOrgID.
findings.title: Secret 'demo/shared' is shared with 999999999999

findings.description: The trust policy of 'deploy' allows 'arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/deploy' from account 999999999999; guard: none.
findings.remediation: Verify the cross-account trust is intended; restrict it to specific role ARNs and require sts:ExternalId (third parties) or aws:PrincipalOrgID (your organisation).
findings.title: Role 'deploy' trusts principal 999999999999

findings.description: The trust policy of 'multi-principal' allows 'arn:aws:iam::999999999999:user/partner' from account 999999999999; guard: none.
findings.remediation: Verify the cross-account trust is intended; restrict it to specific role ARNs and require sts:ExternalId (third parties) or aws:PrincipalOrgID (your organisation).
findings.title: Role 'multi-principal' trusts principal 999999999999

findings.remediation: Require the provider's audience (<host>:aud) and an exact subject (<host>:sub), e.g. repo:<org>/<repo>:ref:refs/heads/main for GitHub or system:serviceaccount:<ns>:<sa> for EKS.
findings.title: Role 'gha-deploy' trusts github identities (pattern subjects)

findings.description: The IAM password policy is below common baselines: password reuse prevention None < 24.
findings.remediation: Set an account password policy: length >= 14, all character classes, reuse prevention 24.
findings.title: The account password policy is weak

findings.description: The trust policy of 'audit' allows 'arn:aws:iam::111122223333:root' from account 111122223333; guard: external-id.
findings.remediation: The trust requires sts:ExternalId; keep the value secret per customer and restrict the principal to the vendor's specific role ARN.
findings.title: Role 'audit' trusts account 111122223333

findings.description: The trust policy of 'wildcard-org' allows Principal '*' guarded only by strong conditions.
findings.remediation: Restrict Principal to specific accounts or role ARNs; conditions on Principal: * are only as strong as their weakest key.
findings.title: Role 'wildcard-org' trusts any AWS principal (Principal: *)

findings.description: Users of the SAML identity provider can assume the role (AssumeRoleWithSAML).
findings.remediation: Confirm the SAML provider and its attribute mapping only admit intended users.
findings.title: Role 'saml-admin' is assumable through SAML provider arn:aws:iam::123456789012:saml-provider/ExampleIdP
